label: hourly canary: IMD transfer count on Ethereum mainnet

input.question: For the one-hour Ethereum mainnet block window ending at this request's pinned head, how many logs emitted by IMD token 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 match Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)? Count each matching log once, including zero-value transfers; the answer is 0 if no logs match.

definitions.event: Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value) emitted by 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 only.
definitions.count: One per log, including mints, burns and zero-value transfers. No logs in the window is 0.
definitions.period: Every block in the pinned window, both ends included.
